items.label: Passport photo-page scan
items.rule: JPG; width 600 px; under 89 KB; scan the passport page containing the applicant photo.

items.label: Applicant's own email address
items.rule: Enter the applicant's own active email address.

items.label: Applicant's own mobile number
items.rule: Enter the applicant's own active mobile number.

items.label: Recent application photo
items.rule: Color photo taken within 6 months; 3.5×4.5 cm; white background; no white clothing; both ears visible; JPG width 100–300 px; 8–14 KB.

items.label: Original passport
items.rule: Bring the same original passport whose copy was submitted during application.
